title: Comparison view — next steps
summary: The plan from the shipped S1+S2 baseline: what the resolver seam already overtook, the two-producer ruling (diff keeps its own prop), and a sequenced list with named write sets — N1 dispatchable today, everything component- or host-facing sequenced behind its owning lane. Lane-readable spec: docs/COMPARISON-NEXT-STEPS.md.
changes: N1 — propertyRows over SceneDiff (S–M, unblocked today): donor propertyRows.ts:216,243 (elementSummaries/orderChanges) re-expressed over our SceneDiff rows. Write set: src/scene/propertyRows.ts + test + new story file + provenance append.

N2 — diff paint on the components (M–L, barrier: components + skin lanes): per-component diff?: DiffMark prop, DIFF_VARIANT_TRAITS ported verbatim as data, channel discipline + the corner rule enforced, changed-AND-broken proven with measured geometry. The research's own call: if only one surface gets built, build this one.
N3 — six-variant gallery (S, after N2): the DIFF_VARIANT_TRAITS rows over one fixture scene, as stories.
S5 — useLinkedCameras + blend (S, barrier: hosts lane): 23 donor lines (BoardRender.tsx:258-280), leader/follower with the re-entrancy latch, host-parameterised. Independent of N2.
S6 — PropertyTable (M, needs N1 + components lane landed): the 583-line donor re-expressed as a shadcn-shaped component over N1's rows.
N6 — CompareView composition story (M, needs N2+S5+S6): the four CVP §5 behaviours proven live at story scale — NOT the 1,127-line dialog, which waits for a consuming app.

S7 — ports as scene records: stays deferred. The resolver seam removed the urgency; un-defer conditions are named (port rename detection, reconcileNodePorts absorption, a third per-port-fields consumer) so this is a decision with an expiry, not a habit.
diff3Scene — not on the list. Unblocked but valueless until a merge/conflict UI exists; building math with no consumer invites drift.
findings: Overtaken: CVP §3's "port-level diff is impossible" is no longer true — diffScene's paired portsOf resolvers (same callback shape as findDanglingEdges) give port add/remove diff today with zero scene-contract change. The honest remainder: port rename detection (ids alone cannot say "renamed") — that belongs to S7 or an {id,label} resolver widening, weighed then, not now.

Overtaken: CVP §6's S1+S2 rows are built, merged and green — verified in this tree today: unit 393/393, stories 47 files / 192 tests, tsc clean. The donor's own wordDiff suite now runs green here (15/15), closing CVP's first "What I could not verify" bullet.
Partially overtaken: S4 — a math-output gallery (4 stories) already exists from the S2 lane; what remains of S4 is the paint gallery, renamed N3, still blocked on N2.

The ruling: diff marks get their own prop; the diff producer never writes into diagnostics. Five grounds (no common order — max(severity) cannot rank added/removed; no common payload; the donor's forbidden dependency arrow; no common lifecycle — lens-scoped vs live-derived; stable ids protect many judgement producers, and diffScene isn't one). Merge rule when both mark one element: both render in full on disjoint channels, halo outside the diff outline, flag owns top-right, no cross-axis precedence. Full argument: COMPARISON-NEXT-STEPS.md §2.

Every donor citation re-verified against the tree today, not carried from memory: CompareDialog 1,127 lines · PropertyTable 583 · propertyRows 247 · useLinkedCameras at BoardRender.tsx:258 · the cableEnds WHY at compareModel.ts:184-187 · BLOCK_STATES at blockModel.ts:214 · DIFF_VARIANT_TRAITS at diffPresentation.ts:99-106 · the diff-must-not-depend-on-lint WHY at diagnosticsModel.ts:48-64.

Builder change riding along: docs/build_lane_report.py grew an optional, backward-compatible sections manifest key (heading + html/html_file + images) — a PLAN's report owes rendered mocks and the capture pipeline alone cannot carry them. Manifests without it are byte-for-byte unchanged.
